decision.reasoning_trace: The search results for 'Backpacks' were significantly diluted with irrelevant items such as camping stoves, travel pillows, leather remnants, and even a paddle board. Within the actual backpack options, many were either niche (disc golf bag, tactical cooler) or had quality concerns mentioned in reviews. While the Seibertron Falcon and ZOMAKE folding pack are respectable products, the overall poor search relevance and lack of variety in standard, high-quality daypacks led me to conclude that I would be better off looking for a purchase on a different site or in a different category search.
